changed_since_2026_10_24: Yes. The hook (prompt-relay.mjs:237) now calls Ask.write, which writes the Prompt task and a v:2 `refined` line by code; the PromptTasks/PromptRecords `live` step it used to feed is switched off (prompt-tasks.off), so the map's mechanisms 1-2 no longer describe the live path. Ask.write is the new single capture writer (also called by Echo.js:357). No new refiner was added; the 8 are otherwise unchanged. last_write for code-only entries is the file's last git commit date (a proxy; data-file dates are given where a data file exists).

mechanisms.name: prompt-relay hook
mechanisms.api: prompt-relay(stdin prompt) -> Ask.write(text, via, re, put) -> Prompt task + {refined:{v:2, sentences, sections}} line on the session
callers: registered .claude/settings.json:251 (hook on every VS Code prompt)
mechanisms.last_write: 2026-11-06 (Ask.mjs last commit); counted Prompt items in the window exist only on 2026-11-04
mechanisms.lesson: Runs on every prompt with no model call, so nothing the owner types in VS Code is ever missed.

mechanisms.name: Ask.write (the one writer)
mechanisms.api: Ask.split(text) = redact secrets + quick_clean -> numbered sentences; Ask.lines(...) -> [content.add Prompt{counted}, refined{v:2}]
mechanisms.lesson: Numbers every sentence (a1, a2...) in one shared splitter, so a later task can cite sentences and coverage is computable.
mechanisms.evidence: Server/Ask.mjs Ask.split; coverage.mjs reuses it (121 VS Code sentences)
mechanisms.cost_note: $0; no v:2 refined line exists in any 11-01..08 session yet

mechanisms.name: PromptTasks + PromptRecords live
mechanisms.api: PromptRecords.live(session, promptLine) -> prompts.jsonl `parts` lines (cites sentence numbers) + up to 15 tasks with source.part
mechanisms.last_write: 2026-11-02 (newest prompts.jsonl); 0 parts lines and 0 source.part tasks in 11-01..08 (coverage.json notes). Switched off by prompt-tasks.off
mechanisms.lesson: Joins each part to a task by `source.part` and cites sentence numbers, which is the only existing way to measure placed/sentences.
mechanisms.evidence: Servex/agents/PromptTasks.js:96; calibration/results.md (Sonnet beats Haiku on parts)

mechanisms.cost_note: off; dead by empty data, not by empty grep (callers still exist)

mechanisms.name: PromptRecords review
mechanisms.api: node Server/PromptRecords.mjs review <session> -> same parts/tasks rules run after the fact, leaning on existing tasks
callers: human CLI only; no hook or schedule
mechanisms.lesson: Reruns the same instructions on a past session, so improved rules can be applied backwards.
mechanisms.evidence: Server/PromptRecords.mjs (last commit 2026-10-25); prompt-refinement-and-tasks.md 'Live and review use the same rules'

mechanisms.name: RefineQueue + RefinedCard
mechanisms.api: RefineQueue.one(transcript turn) -> Haiku refine -> RefinedCard (numbered sentences + asks) -> AskIndex.record/route
mechanisms.lesson: Walks the raw Claude Code transcripts one prompt at a time, so it is the only mechanism that can refine prompts nobody refined live.

mechanisms.name: PromptAudit
mechanisms.api: node Server/PromptAudit.mjs --days 7 -> for each owner prompt, which sentences have no task/note (uncovered list)
mechanisms.lesson: Reports uncovered sentences against the real record, which is the closeout audit the plan asks for.

mechanisms.name: Echo
callers: Servex agent chat path (Servex runs it); Ask.write at Servex/agents/Echo.js:357
mechanisms.lesson: Refines inside Servex with no extra model call, so chat turns get the same numbered sentences as everything else.

mechanisms.name: LiveRefine
mechanisms.api: LiveRefine(session, text) -> model call that streams sections as dictation arrives

mechanisms.name: Day batch tools
mechanisms.api: node Server/DayPromptsRefine.mjs 2026-10-03 [--limit N] [--dry] -> reruns Echo's refine step over a whole day
mechanisms.last_write: 2026-10-04 data (oldest of the group; tools unchanged since)

mechanisms.name: ClaudeCodeTranscript
mechanisms.api: ClaudeCodeTranscript.turns(file) -> [{n, at, line, text}] every owner turn in file order
mechanisms.lesson: Reads the raw transcript, so it sees prompts even when no hook or session record exists.

mechanisms.name: Dictate sentences.add (ChatWriter)
mechanisms.api: ChatWriter -> {sentences:{add:{text}}} + {messages:{add:{type:'Prompt', prompt:id}}} per raw sentence; {place:{...}} files it into the outline
mechanisms.last_write: 2026-11-08 data (262 web-dictation prompts in the window); code 2026-11-03
mechanisms.lesson: Stores every raw sentence untouched as its own row, so the owner's words are never lost or edited.

recommendation: Keep the Ask.write capture plus ONE refiner: PromptRecords parts (Sonnet), run from Ask.write's refined line, because only parts+source.part gives placed/sentences. Port from the others: LiveRefine's live outline fill, PromptAudit's uncovered report as the closeout check, DayPromptsRefine's dry-run backfill.
